accounting: Descriptor records request attempts, captured transport counts/completeness, process raw counts, shared elapsed and null unmetered native cost. Unknown transfer makes aggregate transport/effort decodedBytes null. Internal Docker requests are reported as capture requests, not relabeled providerHTTPcalls. Elapsed is whole operation, not an isolated causal overhead estimate.

configContract.budget: Each enabled config freezes positive per-call values under ceilings. Normally8instrumentation requests plus chosen process; combined raw capture stdin/stdout/stderr count toward maxCaptureBytes; process response separately bounded by existing maxToolOutputBytes. One deadline starts before Capture construction and is reused for preflight/chosen process/export/afterchecks; no fresh export timeout. Session wall budget and elapsed include all phases.
configContract.path: One literal child of/workspace, outside checkout; existing path is not deleted and invalidates freshness only.
configContract.sourceFiles: Sorted unique1..10000retained regular source paths; hashes from host-validated bundle. Exact subset recorded, no whole-tree claim.
configContract.toolPaths: 1..32absolute literal paths mapped to immutable expectedSHA256 or null(observation-only/source-generated unknown hash). Hash observations do not alone prove a source-owned build.

failurePolicy: Missing/stale/unsafe/changed/capped/no-context/receipt/aftercheck exports are unqualified, retaining raw failures. Ordinary command response preserved. Actual shared timeout/cancellation stops session paid continuation. Cancellation retains partial stream and kills client before wait; normal session finally cleans container. Nonzero assertion-like exit may be captured but is never classified as task outcome by runtime.
operationSequence: Raw inspect-before, selected source/tool witness, fixed event-path absent baseline. Errors with remaining budget do not deny arbitrary chosen command.
Run unchanged chosen shell command and retain raw stdout/stderr/argv/hash/exit/error/time receipt before UTF8 display. No permission screening against a hidden correct command.
Before returning tool response, raw inspect-after/witness-after; regular nonlink/single-link bounded event stat+hash; boundedUSTARexport; raw extracted event bytes/hash; second stat+hash consistency.

Host-only descriptor/raw artifacts emitted before tool response; provider receives ordinary shell result only. All state remains unqualified; post-run oracle must check actual command/scope/context/source/tool closure.
optionalConfig: eventCaptures maps frozen repository keys to one common per-repository spec. Absent map preserves normal shell path. No arm-specific branch or hidden command/scorer/gold access. Helper import is lazy; enabled spec binds helperSha256.
remainingPosthocJoin: Independent implementation review before any runtime adoption.

Scorer adapter must bind exact descriptor/raw artifacts/actual tool-call/process/setup/source/tool/effective-target context to frozen expectations/skip policy; currently actual source-origin scorer remains failclosed.
